rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: 2.38 ha regeneration felling notified in Bengtsfors. Completed felling covers 13.7% of the polygon (0.325 ha, from fellings dated 2001-2011), well under the 50% threshold.
No eligible species within 250 m. The only red-listed record in that ring is the mobile bird Poecile montanus (NT, 22 m, uncertainty 250 m, 2023), which is supporting evidence only.

Nine eligible site-bound species are recorded between 272 and 970 m. The nearest is Phellopilus nigrolimitatus (VU, 272 m, 2024, 5 m uncertainty). Others include Hydnellum martioflavum (EN, 334 m), Pannaria conoplea (EN, 435 m) and Hydnellum versipelle (EN, 436 m). Their listed threats include lack of continuity forest, lack of old/large trees or dead wood, and ground disturbance from forestry.

Effort is adequate (1518 records, 632 days, 94th percentile, county median 75), so the lack of eligible records within 250 m is not a low-effort artefact. Near-site effort is thin, though: one observation day and 4 records within 250 m.

uncertainties: The nearest eligible record is at 272 m, only just outside the 250 m HIGH ring. Habitat continuity between it and the polygon is unknown.
Records were not checked against the felling history, so some habitat may already have been felled.
Near-site recording is sparse (one observation day within 250 m).
not_established: That any red-listed species occupies the polygon.
The composition or age of the stand.
That the partially felled 13.7% changes what remains to be reviewed.
next_action: Reviewer should check whether the habitat around the 272-436 m fungus and lichen records extends into the polygon, and consider a field survey before felling starts.
